name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs a person across the insurance programme, worst first

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Severity 1: uninsured, a duty of disclosure or a claim notice at risk, or underinsurance. 2: due soon. 3: housekeeping.
sections.sql: select severity, item, rule, detail, days from programme_attention order by severity, days desc nulls last, item

name: renewals
title: Renewals
subtitle: Every policy in force, when it renews and what is still owed to the insurer

sections.title: Due in the next 120 days
sections.sql: select p.code as policy, p.name, p.insurer, p.period_end as renews, p.days_to_expiry as days, case when p.disclosure_sent_on >= p.period_start then 'sent ' || p.disclosure_sent_on else 'not sent' end as renewal_information, (select count(*) from changes c where c.class = p.class and c.disclosed_on is null)::int as undisclosed_changes from policy_register p where p.status = 'active' and p.renewed_into is null and p.days_to_expiry <= 120 order by p.days_to_expiry

sections.title: Changes not yet told to insurers
sections.sql: select c.code, c.class, c.description, c.occurred_on as happened from changes c where c.disclosed_on is null order by c.occurred_on

sections.title: The programme
sections.sql: select code as policy, class, insurer, period_end as renews, to_char(total_cents / 100, 'FM$999,999,999') as premium, cover from policy_register where status = 'active' order by period_end

name: schedule
title: Schedule of values
subtitle: What is declared to the insurer against what it would cost to replace

sections.title: Under the average clause
sections.note: A claim on these is paid in proportion to the share declared.
sections.sql: select code, name, to_char(declared_cents / 100, 'FM$999,999,999') as declared, to_char(replacement_cents / 100, 'FM$999,999,999') as replacement, pct_declared as pct, average_pct as clause_pct from asset_schedule where active and pct_declared < average_pct order by pct_declared

sections.title: Every asset
sections.sql: select code, entity, policy, kind, name, to_char(declared_cents / 100, 'FM$999,999,999') as declared, pct_declared as pct, valued_on from asset_schedule where active order by policy, kind, code

name: claims
title: Claims
subtitle: Open claims, what is owed on each, and three years of losses by class

sections.title: Open claims
sections.sql: select code, policy, description, discovered_on as found, coalesce(notified_on::text, 'NOT NOTIFIED, due ' || notify_by) as notified, to_char(reserve_cents / 100, 'FM$999,999,999') as reserve, days_quiet from claim_register where status = 'open' order by discovered_on

sections.title: Contractors without current cover
sections.sql: select code, name, trade, state, expires_on from contractor_cover where active and state <> 'current' order by state, code
